designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system defines an elite, modern cloud and web engineering agency rooted in Peru and operating globally. The visual identity breaks firmly away from cold, gloomy cyberpunk tropes and unapproachable enterprise monotony. Instead, it balances high-performance technical competence with optimism, radiant clarity, and warm human hospitality.

### Target Audience & Emotional Impact
- **Audience:** Forward-thinking founders, enterprise CTOs, Latin American tech leaders, and international scale-ups seeking premier cloud architecture and bespoke web craftsmanship.
- **Tone:** Architecturally sound, luminous, precise, transparent, and effortlessly welcoming.
- **Emotional Response:** Confidence, clarity of thought, momentum, and refined modern luxury.

### Visual Style
A tailored hybrid of **Luminous Minimalism** and **Tactile Glass-White Layers**. The interface utilizes a pristine canvas, generous airy whitespace, surgical line-work, vibrant electric blue energy, deliberate conversational triggers (such as WhatsApp green integrations), and gentle chromatic ambient washes (lavender, warm coral, and fresh mint) to signal optimism and boundless altitude.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an intentional, spacious 12-column responsive fluid grid structured inside a maximum content width of 1280px.

### Spatial Rhythm
- **Rhythm Model:** An 8px base unit drives all component padding and vertical margins, preventing micro-misalignments across technical dashboards and public agency pages.
- **Air & Altitude:** Generous padding around feature blocks reinforces an uncluttered, modern cloud perspective. Containers breathe through wide internal padding (`space-xl` on desktop).
- **Responsive Adaptations:**
  - **Desktop (>= 1024px):** 12 columns, 24px gutters, 48px outer canvas margin. Complex cloud architecture diagrams and client results run side-by-side.
  - **Tablet (768px - 1023px):** 8 columns, 20px gutters, 32px canvas margins. 3-column service cards wrap into balanced 2x2 grids.
  - **Mobile (< 768px):** 4 columns, 16px gutters, 20px canvas margins. Linear, single-column vertical flow with full-width conversational CTAs docked or floating safely.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects heavy, murky drops and chaotic cyber overlays in favor of **Luminous Air & Crisp Ghost Borders**.

### Depth Layers
- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Ultra-clean, non-distracting `#F8FAFC` base.
- **Level 1 (Card & Module Layer):** Pure white (`#FFFFFF`) surfaces defined by ultra-fine border definition (`1px solid #E2E8F0`) and diffused atmospheric lift: `0 4px 20px -2px rgba(17, 36, 59, 0.04)`.
- **Level 2 (Hover & Active States):** Enhanced focus, translating -2px on the Y-axis with a subtle chromatic aura: `0 12px 32px -4px rgba(0, 102, 254, 0.08)`.
- **Level 3 (Overlays, Modals, & Conversational Trays):** Semi-opaque floating surfaces with backdrop filter blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`) and crisp borders (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)`), backed by clean ambient shadow: `0 24px 48px -12px rgba(17, 36, 59, 0.12)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Electric Action:** Filled `#0066FE`, crisp white text, fully rounded pill shape (`border-radius: 9999px`), `font-weight: 600`. Hover state triggers a subtle elevation glow and an electric brightness shift (`#0056D6`).
- **Secondary Agency Action:** White fill, `1.5px solid #11243B`, dark ink text. Sharp, high-contrast, confident.
- **WhatsApp Concierge Action:** Tertiary green fill (`#25D366`), white typography and icon, pill-shaped. Accompanied by a gentle live ping indicator to denote immediate human availability.

### Chips & Pill Badges
- **Status & Tech Tags:** 9999px pill shapes, `space-xs` vertical by `space-sm` horizontal padding.
- **Theme Accents:**
  - *Cloud Metric Chip:* Soft lavender surface (`#F1EFFF`), Deep navy text (`#11243B`), border: `1px solid rgba(0, 102, 254, 0.1)`.
  - *SLA Uptime Chip:* Soft mint surface (`#E8FBF2`), WhatsApp green text (`#1EAA52`), pulsing status dot.
  - *Innovation Chip:* Soft coral tint (`#FFF0EE`), coral ink (`#FF6B57`).

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Form Fields:** Crisp white background, `1.5px` border in `#E2E8F0`, 8px corner radius. Focused state: Border transitions to `#0066FE` accompanied by an electric ring `0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 102, 254, 0.15)`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios:** High-contrast Nautical Ink borders, snapping to filled `#0066FE` with crisp white check marks when selected.

### Cards & Case Studies
- **Architecture Showcase Cards:** Built on pure white base layers, framed with low-contrast borders (`#E2E8F0`). Cards feature soft lavender or mint geometric backdrops behind tech diagrams, avoiding cluttered screenshots.
- **Interactive Metrics Cards:** Featuring large Outfit figures (`headline-lg`) in Deep Nautical Ink, accompanied by an electric blue micro-accent line along the top border.

### Direct WhatsApp Floating Trigger
- A permanent, unobtrusive floating pill stationed at the bottom-right viewport margin: `#25D366` background, luminous drop shadow (`0 8px 24px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.3)`), providing instant access to cloud architects with clear micro-copy: "Talk with an Engineer".

### Roles & Accent Strategy
- **Primary (`#0066FE`):** Electric Andean Sky. Used for primary CTAs, active cloud nodes, critical system metrics, and hero interactions.
- **Secondary (`#11243B`):** Deep Nautical Ink. Used for high-contrast headlines, primary text, prominent borders, and anchoring UI structures. Never wash down body text to illegible mid-greys.
- **Tertiary (`#25D366`):** Direct Link Green. Dedicated to live conversational triggers, instant WhatsApp integration, verified uptime badges, and positive system states.
- **Neutral Canvas (`#F8FAFC` to `#FFFFFF`):** High-key white canvas. Zero heavy dark-mode grids or murky digital noise.
- **Chromatic Accents (Surface Tints & Spatial Backdrop Accents):**
  - *Warm Coral (`#FF6B57`):* Special focus tags, latency alerts, and celebratory impact statistics.
  - *Soft Mint (`#E8FBF2`):* Container fill for success metrics, operational health highlights, and client ROI metrics.
  - *Soft Lavender (`#F1EFFF`):* Geometric backdrops, feature isolation cards, and structural pill highlights.

## Typography

The typographic system fuses the bold, architectural geometry of **Outfit** for structural headings with the open, ergonomic legibility of **Plus Jakarta Sans** for running text, system data, and user actions.

- **Legibility First:** Body copy uses Plus Jakarta Sans in neutral ink tints (`#334155`), strictly avoiding low-contrast grey-on-grey degradation.
- **Numbers and Metrology:** System stats, cloud latency counts, and architectural SLAs utilize tabular numbers and medium weights for instant scanning.
- **Mobile Adaptations:** Display titles scale down fluidly past the 768px threshold to prevent awkward word wraps in Spanish and English technical titles.
